Chapter 704 - 704 Annihilation; Mythical Defense Array

704 Annihilation; Mythical Defense Array

Lin Fan’s lecture on the Death Laws suddenly stopped.

As his cultivation state increased, Lin Fan gained a deeper understanding of higher states.

The second-level Universe Realm was an extremely terrifying realm.

[Xing Baokun: Universe Level 2 cultivator, Sky Thunder Sect’s Flying Peak Master. Because you killed his son and disciple Xing Yu, he has a huge hatred towards you. Current Hatred Points: 8 stars.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s heart skipped a beat,”So it’s him.””

All these years, Lin Fan had been cursing him almost every single day. Not only had he given birth to a demonic thought, but he had also caused his soul to be on the verge of collapse.

Lin Fan raised his head slowly and used his Heaven’s Eye to look at the thick clouds.

At this moment, a group of cultivators was flying not far from Earth.

The person in the lead had slightly messy hair and emitted an evil aura.

He… It was Xing Baokun!

Under the observation of the Eyes of Heaven, Xing Baokun’s attacks, weaknesses, and other data all appeared in Lin Fan’s mind.

Very quickly, Lin Fan retracted his gaze, revealing a strange look on his face.

Because, according to the observation of the Eye of Heaven.

One move!

Right now, he only needed one move to kill Xing Baokun. It was as easy as slaughtering a chicken.

….

Xing Baokun, who was standing in the air, said sternly,”Yu ‘er went missing around here?”

“Sir, I did see Xing Yu around here. Later, a terrifying battle broke out here, and I was almost caught up in it.”A short and thin man said in panic.

Xing Baokun looked around, but he did not find anything. He was furious.

He waved his palms wildly in all directions.

It covered the sky and covered the sun, and the world was in turmoil.

The few planets in the distance exploded like fireworks after being hit.

Hundreds of thousands of kilometers in radius turned into nothingness in an instant.

Except…A stone.

“Phew!”

“Damn it!” Xing Yu shouted after waving his palm.”

Then, he turned to leave.

In the next moment, he suddenly noticed that there was still a stone left in the void after being attacked by him. He frowned slightly and said,”What is this?”

One had to know…

Xing Baokun was a Universe Level 2 super warrior.

How vast was his attack?

With his full strength, he could easily turn hundreds of thousands of miles into nothingness.

However, the stone in front of him was still intact.

Something was strange!

Xing Baokun used his spiritual power to wrap around the rock, but it was blocked by a layer of strong membrane on the surface.

This attracted Xing Baokun’s attention once again.

With a slight thought, he took out a large golden blade and slashed at the stone.

The mighty saber aura was like a world-destroying storm that smashed the stone…As well as tens of thousands of kilometers around the stone, it was completely submerged.

A moment later, the blade energy dissipated, but the stone was still intact.

….

“Rumble!”

After the Earth suffered two attacks, there was a loud noise and many places had slight earthquakes.

Lin Fan knew that he couldn’t wait any longer.

“I’ll go settle it.”

After saying that, he disappeared from the Coiling Dragon Villa.

In the next moment, he appeared in front of Xing Baokun.

Without waiting for Xing Baokun to speak, Lin Fan pointed out with his finger.

A golden finger that looked like the sun appeared in the air.

The five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, as well as the intense power of death, were mixed and burned in the golden finger, and they crushed toward Xing Baokun.

Xing Baokun and everyone around him were crushed into nothingness like ants.

It was as if they had never been here before.

It was a killing move!

That was because Lin Fan knew very well that there was no possibility of reconciliation between him and Xing Baokun.

Since that was the case, why waste so much effort?

As for the others…Since he had chosen to be with Xing Baokun, he had to bear the consequences of his choice.

Lin Fan was not in the mood to choose whether they would help Xing Baokun or whether they would leak information about him and Earth.

Dead people were the safest.

[Ding! Killed Universe Level 2 cultivator, obtained 200 million experience points.]

[Ding! Killed a Planet realm sixth layer cultivator. Obtained 60,000 experience points.]

[Ding! Killed Stellar Level 5 cultivator. Obtained 500,000 experience points.]

….

[Ding! Congratulations, you have killed the first Universe-level cultivator. You have received a top-notch metal-type talent, mystic spirit protection array (Emperor level), Transcendence Golden Body x1.]

The surging energy kept surging.

Lin Fan’s entire being had a deeper affinity with the Laws of Metal.

At the same time, an extremely wondrous defensive array technique appeared in his mind.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s lips curled up,” It can raise the Earth’s defense again. Not bad!””

His figure flashed and he returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

First, he said to Han Tian, Su Ningjing, and the others,”It’s fine now.”

Then, he took out Spiritual Crystals, Spiritual Stones, and many other treasures. He arranged them in a specific way and kept writing and carving in the void.

After a full five days, the Mythical Defense Array was successfully set up!

“Buzz!”

At this moment, all the living beings on Earth felt a sense of security.

….

Jiangbei City.

“Lin Cheng Zhen, do you know about the forbidden area?” Li Hao asked.”

“I know.” Lin Chengzhen nodded.”

“I found a very special forbidden area. How about we go in and explore it together?”Li Hao said.

“Not interested,” Lin Chengzhen replied.

His words were very decisive.

That was because he did know about the forbidden area. There was sufficient spiritual energy inside, as well as some spiritual stones, spiritual fruits, and mutated beasts.

This was very attractive to ordinary people.

However, to Lin Chengzhen, it was like a billionaire knowing that there might be a few cents in the garbage dump. He was not interested at all.

That’s right!

That was it!

That was because Lin Chengzhen’s home was in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

The spiritual energy there was countless times more than in the forbidden area.

As for spirit stones and spirit fruits, they were piled up like mountains in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

As for the mutated beasts…In the Coiling Dragon Villa, there was the most powerful exotic beast…Heavenly Hound!

Li Hao didn’t expect Lin Cheng to reject him so quickly. He was slightly stunned.

“Don’t!”

“Lin Chengzhen, do you want to live like this for the rest of your life?”

“Don’t you want to be everyone’s hero?”

“Don’t you want to hug your beautiful sister to sleep when you grow up?”

“Don’t you want Dad and Mom to be proud of us?”

Although Li Hao was only a ten-year-old child.

However, it had to be said that his ability to draw a pie was really good.

However, what about becoming a hero and hugging a beautiful sister to sleep…Lin Chengzhen was not interested at all.

Lin Chengzhen’s heart skipped a beat when he heard that his parents were proud of him.

All these years, wasn’t what he wanted to see the most the approval of his parents?
